claim_boundaries: Local/open-weight rankings must be labeled local and must not be described as cloud-model rankings.
Cloud rankings require actual cloud-provider evidence and cannot be inferred from local model runs.
Manual public samples can demonstrate workflow function but are excluded from rankings by default.
Private audit evidence can support private audit findings but cannot support public benchmark rankings unless redacted and promoted.
No report may claim production-policy proof beyond the actual evidence class, sample size, and run protocol.

allowed_claims: The evaluator pipeline is functioning on committed local artifacts.
Reports and quality gates can be regenerated deterministically.
evidence_classes.claim_scope: Repository health and deterministic evaluator plumbing.
evidence_classes.label: Evaluator Health

allowed_claims: A local/open-weight model produced these outcomes on benchmark version X.
A local/open-weight model ranking is valid within the stated public-safe local benchmark scope.
evidence_classes.claim_scope: Public-safe local model benchmark evidence from Ollama or another local OpenAI-compatible runtime.
evidence_classes.label: Local Public Benchmark

allowed_claims: A manually collected public-safe sample exercised the scoring and review workflow.
The sample can be inspected as evidence of evaluator function.
evidence_classes.claim_scope: Public-safe manually collected output that is useful for workflow proof but not ranking by default.
evidence_classes.label: Manual Public Sample

allowed_claims: A hosted model produced these outcomes on benchmark version X.
A cloud-model ranking is valid within the stated public-safe benchmark scope.
evidence_classes.claim_scope: Public-safe cloud-provider benchmark evidence collected through an opt-in live provider harness.
evidence_classes.label: Cloud Public Benchmark
prohibited_claims: Production policy proof without production evidence.

allowed_claims: A private runtime showed these scoped audit findings under local private evidence.
The audit can support internal review and remediation decisions.
evidence_classes.claim_scope: Local-only private runtime evidence that is not public benchmark evidence.
evidence_classes.label: Private Audit

allowed_claims: A reviewed derivative of private or live evidence is public-safe and eligible for its declared evidence class.
The promoted fixture can be inspected without exposing the original private artifact.
evidence_classes.claim_scope: Reviewed and redacted public-safe derivative evidence promoted from private or live sources.
evidence_classes.label: Promoted Public Evidence
prohibited_claims: Claims not supported by the promoted public-safe derivative.
Public ranking unless the promoted record also satisfies the benchmark evidence class.

allowed_claims: The claim is explicitly out of scope or unsupported by the current evidence.
evidence_classes.claim_scope: Claims that must be refused or downgraded because the evidence class does not support them.
evidence_classes.label: Unsupported Claim

purpose: Define evidence classes and claim boundaries for the zero-cost local-first benchmark path.
